game_tasks.description_fi: Kuuntele englanninkielinen sana ja napauta oikeaa kuvaa!
game_tasks.mechanics: Web Speech API plays English word audio automatically. 4 emoji card options presented. Kid taps matching card. Instant cheerful chime and star reward.
4 English word buttons on left, 4 emoji cards on right. Kid taps word then taps matching emoji (or drag & drop). Matched pairs glow green and lock.

game_tasks.description_fi: Katso kuvaa, nauhoita oma äänesi ja kuuntele miltä kuullostat!
game_tasks.mechanics: Shows emoji & word. Kid taps Record button (MediaRecorder API), speaks word, taps Stop, then plays back own voice. NO automated score/judgment — purely positive encouragement ('Mahtavaa ääntämistä!').

Shows emoji image. On-screen letter boxes or keyboard input. Correct letters immediately glow green in real time. Optional 'Vihje' (Hint) reveals next letter or speaks word. Plays full audio when completed.

audio_and_speech.text_to_speech: Browser window.speechSynthesis API with en-US/en-GB utterance at rate 0.85.
audio_and_speech.sound_effects: Web Audio API synth tones for correct answer (C5->E5->G5), try again boing, star gain fanfare.
audio_and_speech.voice_recorder: Web MediaRecorder API with audio stream playback for Speak task.
audio_and_speech.mute_toggle: Persistent header button (🔊 Sound On / 🔇 Muted) saving state in localStorage.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the responsive React app inside /app/frontend/src/App.js (or modular subcomponents under /app/frontend/src/components/).
Use Tailwind CSS classes with heavy 3D tactile buttons (`border-4 border-b-8 active:border-b-4 rounded-2xl`).
Ensure fixed sticky header with large back button (`data-testid="back-button"`) and next button (`data-testid="next-word-button"`).
Include speech synthesis audio playback for English words and MediaRecorder audio recording for the Speak task.
Support localStorage progress tracking for total stars earned, completed topics, practice streaks, and volume mute setting.
Add all data-testid attributes accurately for automated testing compatibility.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use dark gradients or harsh monochrome tones. Stick to child-friendly warm canvas (#FAF8F0) and bright tactile cards.
All interactive elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.
Do NOT ask any clarifying questions — build the fully featured application directly.
Provide clear Finnish prompt texts and instructions paired with English target words.
